_comment: Picture-led beats: a silent stretch of `dur` seconds (parts) / `ldur` (the long film) inserted after the sentence that starts with `after`, while the idea plays out on the painting (counter gliding, tide climbing, push-ins) with music and SFX. `approach` beats carry `arrives`: the counter reaches that distance as the beat ends.

ch1.after: Right now, it is drifting away
About the same size as the Sun.

ch2.after: One quarter of the way in.
The Moon looks one and a third times wider.
Not enough to see on the beach

ch3.after: So half the distance means about eight times

ch4.after: So a full Moon gives about six and a half times
The wet sand shines like a mirror.
The water has a silver road

ch5.after: That is why total solar eclipses are possible.

ch6.after: Its tidal pull is more than a hundred sixty
With far more pull, it would flex far more.

ch7.after: A moon that orbits faster rises in the west.
The Moon hangs in your sky, almost still.
Then it begins to slide the wrong way

ch8.after: It is a wall of grey
